|game_text='''0 side — On The Verge Of Greatness'''

Deploy [Set 16] Death Star and Scarif systems, Citadel Tower, Commence Primary Ignition, and Shield Gate. For remainder of game, you may not deploy characters of ability > 4 (except Vader). Vader is power +2 and he (or a Star Destroyer he is piloting) may make a regular move to a battle just initiated. While this side up, once per turn, may deploy a site (or Imperial trooper) to Scarif from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if Krennic or Tarkin on Scarif and Death Star orbiting Scarif.

'''7 side — Taking Control Of The Weapon'''

While this side up, your Force generation is +2 for each 'blown away' Scarif site. Tarkin Doctrine is immune to Alter and, when it initiates Force loss, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile. Once per turn, if opponent's character just lost from your site, may place it out of play unless opponent loses 1 Force. Tarkin adds 3 to total of Commence Primary Ignition. Flip this card if you have no leaders on Scarif. Place this card out of play if Shield Gate not on table or if Death Star has been 'blown away.'

The PC published pixel-identical copies on 5 July 2022 (format change only). '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the images only: the PC re-rendered the Virtual Set 16 card images (credit and copyright lines and the typesetting of the game text changed); the game text words are the same. A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon (Errata 2)]]): PC errata of 9 March 2026; both card images marked E1 published 9 March 2026, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E2-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/onthevergeofgreatness.gif</code> as published 9 March 2026: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/onthevergeofgreatness.gif holotable commit 6f23e07] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="img-PC-E2-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/takingcontroloftheweapon.gif</code> as published 9 March 2026: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/takingcontroloftheweapon.gif holotable commit 6f23e07] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “On The Verge Of Greatness: Deploy [Set 16] Death Star and Scarif systems, Citadel Tower, and Shield Gate. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Endor Shield, non-Imperial characters, or non-Imperial starships. Once per turn, may deploy a Scarif battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your non-unique Imperials, vehicles, and capital starships are deploy -1 (-2 if a Star Destroyer). Non-unique Imperials are forfeit +1. Flip this card if Krennic or Tarkin at a Scarif battleground site and Death Star orbiting Scarif. Taking Control Of The Weapon: While this side up, A Bright Center To The Universe cancels opponent's Force drain modifiers everywhere. Vader may make a regular move to a battle just initiated. At Death Star, system it orbits, and sites related to either, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if your non-unique card with ability in battle). During your draw phase, may retrieve a non-unique card with ability. Flip this card if you do not have a leader at a Scarif battleground site. Place out of play if Death Star or Shield Gate not on table.” The card prints E1; this is the second change counted here, so its version code is PC-E2. The PC card data's errata note (9 March 2026) quotes the previous 0-side text. '''What changed:''' Both sides were rewritten. 0 side: “Commence Primary Ignition” was dropped from the deploy list; the restriction “characters of ability > 4 (except Vader)” and the Vader bonus were replaced by “you may not deploy Endor Shield, non-Imperial characters, or non-Imperial starships”; the once-per-turn deploy now takes a Scarif battleground (any time, not only while this side up); non-unique Imperials, vehicles and capital starships deploy -1 (-2 if a Star Destroyer) and non-unique Imperials are forfeit +1; the flip needs Krennic or Tarkin at a Scarif battleground site. 7 side: the whole text was replaced (A Bright Center To The Universe cancels opponent's drain modifiers; Vader may move to a battle just initiated; battle destiny +1 (+2) at Death Star and related locations; draw-phase retrieval of a non-unique card with ability; new flip and out-of-play conditions). Both sides gained the E1 mark.
